API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIDelegated Tenant AdministrationGets all configured Microtenants for the specified customer.
Gets all configured Microtenants for the specified customer.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/microtenants

Gets all configured Microtenants for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Example: 20
includeRoles
boolean

Include roles information in the API response.

Default value: false
